verdict.rationale: Vue's own docs explicitly state it 'builds on top of standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript' with single-file components separating these concerns, and multiple independent developers corroborate a fast, hours-long learning curve using familiar syntax (vue-comm-9, vue-comm-12, vue-comm-13, vue-comm-15). Minor caveats around Composition API complexity and build tooling exist but don't contradict the core template/HTML/CSS/JS authoring model. Missing for 10: no formal independent study/benchmark on learning curve beyond anecdotal HN comments.
